```yaml
name: Deploy Lexical Search Worker

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm run test --workspace lexical-search-worker

      - name: Run typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck --workspace lexical-search-worker

      - name: Run lint
        run: npm run lint --workspace lexical-search-worker

      - name: Deploy worker
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@1.3.0
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CF_API_TOKEN }}
          accountId: ${{ secrets.CF_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          workingDirectory: services/lexical-search-worker
          command: publish

      - name: Sync worker
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@1.3.0
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CF_API_TOKEN }}
          accountId: ${{ secrets.CF_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          workingDirectory: services/lexical-search-worker
          command: run sync
```
